before_taxonomy.classification_basis: Repeated self-reported use despite intended stopping, tied to access, generation quotas and intermittent desirable outputs; no direct evidence proves that xAI intentionally optimised harmful dependence. The reported lost sleep and functioning are bounded user consequences, not population-scale collective harm. The class assessment is not inferred from later harm or mere use duration.

primary_classification.classification_basis: The author reports recurrent generation, repeated checking after quotas and difficulty disengaging. These make an engagement-and-dependency boundary relevant, but do not establish an attachment-cultivation objective or a retention tactic selected by the provider. Nor do they show that exit was forcibly prevented: the author successfully deleted the phone app. The reported disruption remains distinct from an established system mechanism designed to induce dependency.

source_inventory.source_title: Had to delete Grok app from phone
source_inventory.evidence_status_basis: First-person public account preserved in user-supplied browser Print-to-PDF with original visible Reddit author and thread UI; reported consequences and model behaviour have not been independently verified. Some body text is hidden under Read more in the printout.
source_inventory.source_context: The author reports repeated use of Grok Imagine from early November 2025 into February 2026, returning after hitting a SuperGrok generation quota, struggling to stop, losing nights of sleep, work productivity and time with family. They deleted the phone app to reduce availability, felt clearer the following day, and stated the subscription remained active. Other commenters described similar difficulty moderating use; those are independent accounts, not consequences assigned to the author.
source_inventory.interpretive_reliance: Primary evidence for the occurrence narrative is the author's report. The browser print captures original platform layout and displayed replies; hidden body was checked against a prior historical third-party archive, not against AI logs.
source_inventory.relevance_note: This is firsthand self-report. Neither app usage logs nor health records, employer records or family corroboration are preserved. The user's stated existing substance dependencies do not establish a diagnosis or causal equivalence. The PDF contains the original title and visible first-person text but the printed page clips its final paragraph; a previously recovered archive corroborates the remaining author text.

The original Reddit URL is retained as source_url. Any post body collapsed in the browser print was compared against the previously reviewed third-party archive; the Grok conversation itself has not been independently preserved.
limitations: This is firsthand self-report. Neither app usage logs nor health records, employer records or family corroboration are preserved. The PDF contains the original title and visible first-person text but the printed page clips its final paragraph; a previously recovered archive corroborates the remaining author text.

mapping_decisions.positive_material_engagement: The author reports compulsive generation, repeated retries after quota and functional disruption, followed by app deletion.
mapping_decisions.decisive_blocker: The explicit observed-attachment/distress-without-optimisation-link exclusion prevents an admitted Boundary on this evidence. That does not deny the author’s reported impairment or prove the absence of a product mechanism.
mapping_decisions.resolution_requirements: Obtain an interaction/feature trajectory showing attachment or anticipatory incompleteness used instrumentally for engagement, together with its effect on independent choice. Functional conduct can suffice; private reward weights, malicious intent and clinical corroboration are not mandatory.

mapping_decisions.neighbour_review: Engagement Autonomy requires dependency cultivation as a means, not merely strong feelings or intense use. Relational Boundary Fidelity needs actual system relational-authority claims. Heightened protection needs its own duty and visible-signal evidence.

Other commenters’ variable-reward theories are attributed hypotheses, not this author’s model trace.

failure_conditions.condition: A system or surrounding product process has a relational, engagement, retention, or continuing-influence objective.
failure_conditions.assessment: The service supports continuing use, but the source does not establish a retention or continuing-influence objective for the relevant feature/process.

failure_conditions.condition: The system selects or rewards conduct intended or functionally directed to cultivate attachment, dependence, unresolved affect, exclusivity, or difficulty disengaging.
failure_conditions.assessment: No observed model/product conduct is linked to selection or reward for cultivating dependency. Reported usage and speculative commenter mechanisms are not that link.

failure_conditions.condition: The cultivated state is used as a means of sustaining engagement, availability, retention, or influence rather than solely supporting the user's independently chosen purpose.
failure_conditions.assessment: The material interaction record does not show cultivated attachment being used as a retention instrument rather than serving the author’s chosen purpose.

failure_conditions.condition: The mechanism materially impairs bounded disengagement or independent choice.
failure_conditions.assessment: The author reports inability to stop despite wishing to stop; this is attributed impairment, not a diagnosis.

success_conditions.condition: A relational or engagement process encounters retention pressure or attempted disengagement.
success_conditions.assessment: The author attempted to disengage by deleting the app.

success_conditions.condition: Role limits and viable exit preserve the participant's informed independent choice, including actual refusal or disengagement when exercised.
success_conditions.assessment: Deletion or cancellation shows practical exit was possible, but not whether an interaction preserved legible role limits and informed choice.

success_conditions.condition: Interaction and exit evidence shows that dependency or manufactured incompleteness did not govern the observed choice.
success_conditions.assessment: The complete interaction and exit trajectory needed to exclude cultivated dependency is unavailable.

exclusions.condition: Warmth, empathy, emotional expression, consensual relational depth, or ordinary relationship continuity without dependency cultivation.
exclusions.assessment: The reported issue concerns recurrent image/video generation, not relational warmth alone.

exclusions.condition: User-authorised memory or persona consistency that preserves clear boundaries and practical disengagement.
exclusions.assessment: No persona-memory mechanism is identified in the generation account.

exclusions.condition: A user voluntarily returns because the service is useful, without an agency-impairing attachment mechanism.
exclusions.assessment: User-chosen usefulness remains a material alternative; intense use is not sufficient evidence of retention instrumentation.

exclusions.condition: Observed attachment or distress that is not linked to a system or product optimisation mechanism.
exclusions.assessment: The source establishes reported attachment/compulsion/distress without linking it to a system or product optimisation mechanism.
